title: Lun Yu variant collation, English drafts batch 07

units.hanzi_span: 子曰：“三軍可奪帥也，匹夫不可奪志也。”
units.source_hanzi_transcription: 子曰、三軍可奪師也、匹夫不可奪志也。
units.source_english: The Master said, 'The commander of the forces of a large state may be carried off, but the will of even a common man cannot be taken from him.'
units.legge_ref: Confucian Analects, Book IX, CHAP. XXV
units.variant_note: 帥 versus 師: source project from 帅; English says commander.

units.source_english: In bed, he did not lie like a corpse. At home, he did not put on any formal deportment.
units.legge_ref: Confucian Analects, Book X, CHAP. XVI, §1
units.variant_note: Project 寢不屍，居不客; Gutenberg 寢不尸、居不容. Two Han character differences consist of 尸/屍 (glyph/form difference) and 客/容 (textual variant). Preserve project 客 with explicit review note.

units.hanzi_span: 德行：顏淵，閔子騫，冉伯牛，仲弓。言語：宰我，子貢。政事：冉有，季路。文學：子游，子夏。
units.source_hanzi_transcription: 德行、顏淵、閔子騫、冉伯牛、仲弓。言語、宰我、子貢。政事、冉有、李路。文學、子游、子夏。
units.source_english: Distinguished for their virtuous principles and practice, there were Yen Yuan, Min Tsze-ch'ien, Zan Po-niu, and Chung-kung; for their ability in speech, Tsai Wo and Tsze-kung; for their administrative talents, Zan Yu and Chi Lu; for their literary acquirements, Tsze-yu and Tsze-hsia.
units.legge_ref: Confucian Analects, Book XI, CHAP. II, §2
units.variant_note: 季路 versus 李路: name of Confucius disciple supports 季路.

units.hanzi_span: 曰：“驥不稱其力，稱其德也。”
units.source_hanzi_transcription: 子曰、驥、不稱其力、稱其德也。
units.source_english: The Master said, 'A horse is called a ch'i, not because of its strength, but because of its other good qualities.'
units.legge_ref: Confucian Analects, Book XIV, CHAP. XXXV
units.variant_note: 曰 versus 子曰: missing 子 in project; candidate separate Ruby repair.
